added.summary: `key auto <tolerance> holes` also keys enclosed pockets of the background colour that the border flood does not reach (the magenta inside a slash arc); `og sprite inspect --holes` measures the same and its report counts texels near the key that are still drawn (`nearKey`).
A `source` block takes `scale`, multiplied by the sheet's, so a clip drawn larger than the others is brought to their size.

`crop each` cuts every source to its own drawn bounds and shelf-packs the cells into one atlas, each with its own pivot: loose PNGs become one sheet. The cook note reports the packed size and the drawn share.

fixed.member: flipbook cook: key auto on generated GIFs
fixed.summary: `key auto` took a quantised flat border (near shades straddling the colour buckets, as a GIF encoder writes them) for a non-flat one and refused the sheet; the border colour is now the mean of the texels near its mode.

fixed.member: og.destruction carve2d, fill2d, explode2d, fracture2d in a system
fixed.summary: They threw "not available while a system runs" when called from a system's tick; they now use the running system's context.
